name: US Census Bureau Geocoder (geographies/coordinates)
input: lon/lat (coordinates) or address (onelineaddress/address); batch CSV up to 10,000 records
returns: States, Counties (5-digit FIPS), County Subdivisions, Incorporated Places (7-digit place GEOID, FUNCSTAT, LSADC), Census Designated Places, tracts, blocks, congressional/legislative districts, urban areas. Tested 2026-11-14 with downtown Las Vegas point: returned Las Vegas city (GEOID 3240000), Clark County (32003), Nevada (32).
routingUse: Primary router: if an Incorporated Place is returned, the city is the likely electrical AHJ; if only a Census Designated Place (e.g., unincorporated Paradise/Enterprise NV) or nothing is returned, route to the county. Combine with nec-adoption-by-state scope (local-only/partial states need the local layer).
limits: Batch 10,000 records/file; no documented rate limit or key in the API doc read; no CORS (call server-side).
terms: US government public service; terms not stated in the doc read.

name: FCC Area API (Census block lookup)
returns: Block FIPS (15-digit), county FIPS + name, state FIPS/code/name. Does NOT return incorporated place. Tested 2026-11-14 (Las Vegas point -> block 320030007003025, Clark County 32003, NV).
routingUse: Fast fallback for state/county when Census geocoder is slow/down; derive place via TIGERweb or Census geocoder.
limits: Not stated on the page read.
terms: FCC page says the APIs are free for anyone subject to FCC API terms of service and website policies.

name: Census TIGERweb ArcGIS REST (tigerWMS_Current)
returns: Polygons/attributes for layers incl. 22 County Subdivisions, 28 Incorporated Places, 30 Census Designated Places, 34 Tribal Subdivisions, 80 States, 82 Counties (layer ids read from service JSON 2026-11-14).
routingUse: Point-in-polygon for places/counties; also tribal areas (where state code may not apply).
limits: Standard ArcGIS max record count; not documented in what was read.

name: Census Gazetteer Files (2026)
returns: Identifier codes, names, area, representative lat/lon for states, counties, county subdivisions, places, etc. (2026 and 2025 vintages).
routingUse: Offline name->GEOID table for town-name queries (e.g., "Henderson NV" -> place GEOID) and centroid fallback.

name: 2022 Census of Governments - Government Units Listing
returns: List of governments with reference information (fields not confirmed from page read; expected to include government type and FIPS — verify).
routingUse: Enumerate counties/municipalities/townships that could be AHJs; join on FIPS with geocoder output.

name: NFPA NEC Enforcement Maps (state table)
input: HTML page; state table embedded in page JSON
returns: Per-state NEC edition in effect, effective date, pending update status, links to state agencies; NFPA summary counts (as of 2026-08-03).
routingUse: State-level NEC edition seed; refresh periodically. Lags state actions by weeks/months (e.g., TX, OR, MT changes after 2026-08-03).
terms: NFPA copyrighted page; store facts only (third_party_link_only).

name: FEMA Building Code Adoption Tracking (BCAT)
returns: Jurisdiction-level hazard-resistant I-code adoption status (based on ISO BCEGS data + FEMA research), updated quarterly per search excerpts. Does not track NEC.
routingUse: Possible list of local building-code jurisdictions; not an electrical AHJ dataset. Download path not confirmed (fema.gov returned 403 to scripted fetch).

name: NERA members map data feed
returns: Per state: type (Member State / Similar Licensing Requirements), licensing board name, address, website_url.
routingUse: Map destination state -> state electrical licensing board and reciprocity-group membership.

name: No national dataset of electrical AHJs/building departments found
routingUse: Recommended approach: geocode -> incorporated place or county (Census) -> per-state rule (statewide vs local-only from nec-adoption-by-state.json) -> curated per-jurisdiction table (built by state agents). ICC/UpCodes adoption databases exist but are third-party/licensed and were not used.
